Hush... That is not something we should speak of.}} '''Yngvar''' is a quest-exclusive [[NPC]] that first appears in [[Ode to the Second Sunrise]]. He is the successor for the title of "The Eye" in the [[Heliodic Six]]. ==Quests and Events== {{Quests and Events}} ==Profile== Often skipping ceremonies and neglecting his duties as a Foreseer to the Heliodic Six, Yngyar's qualification to being a successor is often questioned by other Roya members. It is later revealed he did not wish to succeed "The Eye" and become a member of the [[Heliodic Six]], chosen only for his Resonance Ability. To escape his fate, he aligns himself with the [[Fractsidus]] to destroy the Heliogyre in exchange for a pass to [[New Federation]]. ==Character Mentions== {{Character Mentions}} {{Dialogue Start}} ;(Down the stairs of Solisylum) :'''Angry Shepard:''' Yngvar never even bothered to care about the Soliskin. And he never joins the ceremonies. How was he chosen as one of the Heliodic Six's future successors? :'''Nervous Roya:''' Let's not talk about this here... :'''Angry Shepard:''' Why is that? Are you afraid? I'm simply stating the facts. Among all the candidates, [[Sigrika]] is clearly the one who meets the necessary qualifications! ---- ;(After completion of {{Quest|Ode to the Second Sunrise}}) :;Did you hear Yngvar is subject to disciplinary action by the Solisylum? :;Serves him right! I told you he never deserved to be a successor in the first place! :;I knew it! Yngvar walks a crooked path. :;To think, even one named a successor to the Heliodic Six could fall to treachery... :;'''Herja''' To think it was Yngvar who did such a thing... :;'''Aksel''' Sigh... :'''Herja:''' Ah. I felt it in my gut, but to think it was Yngvar who did such a thing... :'''Aksel:''' From the Void Storm we pulled him, Herja. And now by our own hands, to judgement he goes. It is a closed circle. :{{DIcon}} Hello. :'''Aksel:''' Ah, the Predicted One? We meet again. Welcome to Haldarheim. :{{DIcon}} So what happened to Yngvar in the end? :'''Aksel:''' Sigh... :'''Aksel:''' Everything changed the day of that Void Storm. When the sky brightenened again, a Soliskin found us. We followed it into Bjartr Woods, and there, Yngvar we found, unconcious. :'''Aksel:''' He had no fatal wounds, only signs of scorching. We brought him back to Haldarheim to recover. :{{DIcon}} (Sounds like Mornye gave Yngvar a good thrashing.) :'''Aksel:''' When he woke, silence he kept. But then, those from the Solisylum came. The truth of his deeds they laid bare, and he broke down and wept, confessing everything. :'''Aksel:''' To the Solisylum's custody, he has been given. His punishment will not be pleasant. :{{DIcon}} And the world rejoices. :{{DIcon}} A bitter end, at any rate. :'''Herja:''' Outcasts, both his parents were. Aksel and I brought him out of the Void Storm and raised him to manhood in our tribe. We thought... we had saved him... :'''Aksel:''' No matter how it ends, he chose this path.
